Synopsis:
Australian data centre operator NextDC reported worsening water (WUE: 2.40) and energy efficiency (PUE: 1.49) metrics for the third consecutive year, driven by portfolio growth and newly commissioned capacity. Despite this, the company beat earnings forecasts, swinging to a A$82.1M profit. The article contextualises results within a global regulatory trend of governments restricting data centre construction due to grid strain and water consumption concerns, with Australia's Canberra government weighing mandatory efficiency standards and on-site renewable generation requirements.
